arxiv-1501-03790.title: On ’t Hooft–Polyakov Monopole, Julia–Zee Dyon, and Higgs Field, throughout the Generalized Bogomoln’yi Equations
arxiv-1501-03790.creator: Lukasz Andrzej Glinka
arxiv-1501-03790.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Lukasz Andrzej Glinka. In this paper, making use of the ’t Hooft–Polyakov–Julia–Zee ansatz for the S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) Yang–Mills–Higgs gauge field theory, we present the straightforward generalization of the Bogomoln’yi equations and its several consequences.

arxiv-2102-03459.title: A Rapid Method For Orbital Coverage Statistics With 𝐉 𝟐 \mathbf{J_{2}} Using Ergodic Theory
arxiv-2102-03459.creator: Andrew J. Graven, Alan H. Barr, and Martin W. Lo
arxiv-2102-03459.description: Abstract Quantifying long-term statistical properties of satellite trajectories typically entails time-consuming trajectory propagation. We present a fast, ergodic [ 1 ] method of analytically estimating these for J 2 − J_{2}- perturbed elliptical orbits, broadly agreeing with trajectory propagation-derived results.

arxiv-2311-07202.title: Real-Time Machine-Learning-Based Optimization Using Input Convex Long Short-Term Memory Network Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2311-07202.creator: Zihao Wang, Donghan Yu, Zhe Wu
arxiv-2311-07202.description: Abstract Neural network-based optimization and control methods, often referred to as black-box approaches, are increasingly gaining attention in energy and manufacturing systems, particularly in situations where first-principles models are either unavailable or inaccurate. However, their non-convex nature significantly slows down the optimization and control processes, limiting their application in real-time decision-making processes.

arxiv-2402-13459.title: Learning to Poison Large Language Models for Downstream Manipulation
arxiv-2402-13459.creator: Xiangyu Zhou, Yao Qiang, Saleh Zare Zade, Mohammad Amin Roshani, Prashant Khanduri, Douglas Zytko, Dongxiao Zhu
arxiv-2402-13459.description: Abstract The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has marked significant achievements in language processing and reasoning capabilities. Despite their advancements, LLMs face vulnerabilities to data poisoning attacks, where the adversary inserts backdoor triggers into training data to manipulate outputs.

arxiv-2407-13667.title: Kinematic constraints on the ages and kick velocities of Galactic neutron star binaries
arxiv-2407-13667.creator: P. Disberg, N. Gaspari, A. J. Levan
arxiv-2407-13667.description: Abstract Context. The systems creating binary neutron stars (BNSs) experience systemic kicks when one of the components goes supernova. The combined magnitude of these kicks is still a topic of debate, and has implications for the eventual location of the transient resulting from the merger of the binary.

arxiv-2412-15685.title: Shiftable Heffter Spaces
arxiv-2412-15685.creator: M. Buratti, A. Pasotti
arxiv-2412-15685.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by M. Buratti, A. Pasotti. The shiftable Heffter arrays are naturally generalized to the shiftable Heffter spaces. We present a recursive construction which starting from a single shiftable Heffter space leads to infinitely many other shiftable Heffter spaces of the same degree. We also present a direct construction making use of pandiagonal magic squares leading to a shiftable ( 16 ​ ℓ 2 , 4 ​ ℓ , 3 ) (16\ell^{2},4\ell;3) Heffter space for any ℓ ≥ 1 \ell\geq 1 .

arxiv-2504-20595.title: ReasonIR: Training Retrievers for Reasoning Tasks
arxiv-2504-20595.creator: Rulin Shao, Rui Qiao, Varsha Kishore, Niklas Muennighoff, Xi Victoria Lin, Daniela Rus, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low, Sewon Min, Wen-tau Yih, Pang Wei Koh, Luke Zettlemoyer
arxiv-2504-20595.description: Abstract We present ReasonIR-8B , the first retriever specifically trained for general reasoning tasks. Existing retrievers have shown limited gains on reasoning tasks, in part because existing training datasets focus on short factual queries tied to documents that straightforwardly answer them.

arxiv-2505-12515.title: Normal invariant of nearby Lagrangians via twisted derivative
arxiv-2505-12515.creator: M. Abouzaid and D. Álvarez-Gavela and S. Courte and T. Kragh
arxiv-2505-12515.description: Abstract . Let L L and M M be closed, connected, smooth manifolds and let L ↪ T ∗ ​ M L\hookrightarrow T^{*}M be an exact Lagrangian embedding. The induced map L → M L\to M is known by earlier work to be a homotopy equivalence.

arxiv-2510-04778.title: Integral of the double-emission eikonal function for two massive emitters at an arbitrary angle Preprint: TTP25-031, P3H-25-067
arxiv-2510-04778.creator: Ming-Ming Long, Kirill Melnikov, Andrey Pikelner
arxiv-2510-04778.description: Abstract We present a semi-analytic calculation of the integrated double-emission eikonal function of two massive emitters whose momenta are at an arbitrary angle to each other. This result is needed for extending the nested soft-collinear subtraction scheme caola:2017dug to processes with massive partons.

arxiv-2601-17595.title: Water Cherenkov Detectors in Precision Agriculture: A Novel Approach for High-Resolution Soil Moisture Monitoring Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research A
arxiv-2601-17595.creator: Christian Sarmiento-Cano, Jaime Betancour, Alejandro Núñez Selin, Luigui Miranda-Leuro, Iván Sidelnik, Hernán Asorey, Luis A. Núñez
arxiv-2601-17595.description: Abstract Water Cherenkov Detectors (WCDs), traditionally employed in cosmic-ray detection, are repurposed here for precision soil moisture monitoring using cosmic-ray neutron sensing. This approach offers advantages over conventional neutron probes, including enhanced sensitivity to low moisture levels and the ability to cover larger soil volumes without subsurface intrusion.

pmc-10561792.title: Limited English Proficiency Is Associated With Diabetic Retinopathy in Patients Presenting for Cataract Surgery
pmc-10561792.creator: Zafar S. Gill, A. Itzam Marin, Anne Strong Caldwell, Nihaal Mehta, Nathan Grove, Leonard K. Seibold, Michael A. Puente, Talisa E. De Carlo Forest, Scott C. N. Oliver, Jennifer L. Patnaik, Niranjan Manoharan

Patients who self-identified as needing or preferring an interpreter were defined as having LEP.

pmc-11569876.title: A peptide against the N-terminus of myristoylated alanine-rich C kinase substrate promotes neuronal differentiation in SH-SY5Y human neuroblastoma cells
pmc-11569876.creator: Jannatul FERDOUS, Kiyotada NAITOU, Mitsuya SHIRAISHI
pmc-11569876.description: Myristoylated alanine-rich protein kinase C substrate (MARCKS) plays crucial roles in neuronal functions and differentiation. However, specific effects of the myristoylated N-terminal sequence (MANS) peptide, a widely used MARCKS modulator comprising the initial 24 amino acids of MARCKS, on neuronal cells remain unclear.

pmc-12376965.title: Single-Cell Approaches Define the Murine Leptomeninges: Cortical Brain Interface as a Distinct Cellular Neighborhood Composed of Neural and Non-neural Cell Types

pmc-12376965.description: The interface barrier between the brain surface and the adjacent meninges is important for regulating exchanges of fluid, protein, and immune cells between the CNS and periphery. However, the cell types that form this important interface are not yet fully defined.

pmc-12536754.title: Central Centrifugal Cicatricial Alopecia: A Survey of Treatment Practices Among Dermatology Residents and Attending Physicians
pmc-12536754.creator: Janet Choi, Isabelle Ilan, Jin Ning Tian, Eliza Balazic, Christy Nwankwo, Kseniya Kobets
pmc-12536754.description: IntroductionCentral centrifugal cicatricial alopecia (CCCA) is a type of primary scarring alopecia characterized by hair loss on the vertex of the scalp. While treatment often focuses on reducing inflammation, no established standard of care exists. Early diagnosis and intervention are critical, as advanced stages with permanent follicular scarring are challenging to treat.

pmc-13184440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Neuropsychiatric disorders represent a significant global health burden. Despite decades of research, current treatments typically provide only symptomatic relief, rather than addressing the underlying mechanisms of these conditions. Historically, research focused on the dopaminergic and serotonergic systems, which are deeply involved in the pathophysiology of many mental health disorders, including depression, schizophrenia, anxiety, autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and different substance use disorders, including alcohol use disorder (AUD).

pmc-13335604.description: This work employs a hydrothermal embedding strategy to fabricate a highly efficient and stable Pd/SnO2 catalyst for CO oxidation. pmc-13394209.title: Occurrence and clinical correlates of depressive symptoms in adults with epilepsy: A study in Georgia
pmc-13394209.creator: Ketevan Silagadze, Eka Burkadze, Maka Areshidze, Teimuraz Silagadze, Sofia Kasradze, Josemir W Sander
pmc-13394209.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13682021.title: Smoking status and survival by cancer type and treatment intent in a population-based cohort with adjustment for major prognostic factors
pmc-13682021.creator: E Heervä, A Ellonen, S Kukkurainen, T Mikkola, K Savolainen, T Laitinen, K Mattila, H Blomster, H Minn, H Irjala, A Karlsson, M Bärlund, P Österlund
pmc-13682021.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTobacco smoking after cancer diagnosis is associated with impaired survival but large real-world evidence across cancers accounting for treatment intent and key prognostic factors remains scarce. We evaluated associations between smoking and survival in a population-based cohort.Materials and methodsWe identified all patients who were diagnosed with solid cancers (International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision codes C00-C43, C45-C68) and treated at two Finnish university hospitals (2009-2019).
